integrity: Proof supplied in RESULT.md and reproducibility scripts; reported checks were run from the included standalone verifier. No independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: This lower bound is restricted to finite ultrametrics with the fixed three-distance alphabet. It does not provide a matching upper bound or classify every polynomial fiber. Earlier work covers the ball/type correspondence and the finite five-point nonrigidity witness; only the quantitative exponential fiber lower bound is newly asserted. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Exponential non-reconstruction from graded singleton types over three-level ultrametrics
